newsitem.title: USA: MotivePower unit wins $10 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: MotivePower unit wins $10 mln contract.

text.p: Boise Locomotive Co said on Thursday that it won a $10 million contract to overhaul 24 locomotives, with an option for an additional 20.
The locomotives are scheduled to be leased to Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp by an unnamed third party under a separate agreement, Boise Locomotive said in a statement.

"This key project represents a significant addition to our second-half backlog," said Boise Locomotive president Joseph Crawford. Boise Locomotive is a subsidiary of MotivePower Industries, which manufactures and distributes engineered locomotive components.
